model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between iteration number and loss value for several models. The x-axis is labeled "#Iteration" and uses a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 140000 with tick labels at every 20000 increments. The y-axis is labeled "Loss" and uses a linear scale, ranging from 2.4 to 3.4. A purple, solid line with no marker represents "Vanilla," starting at approximately 3.3 and decreasing to approximately 2.6 by iteration 140000. An orange, solid line with no marker represents "StrmLLM," starting at approximately 3.2 and decreasing to approximately 2.5 by iteration 140000. A red, solid line with no marker represents "SepLLM," beginning at approximately 3.3 and decreasing to approximately 2.6 by iteration 140000. A green, solid line with no marker represents "SepLLM (n=64, H)," initiating at approximately 3.2 and declining to approximately 2.5 by iteration 140000. A brown, solid line with no marker represents "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)," beginning at approximately 3.0 and decreasing to approximately 2.4 by iteration 140000. A blue, solid line with no marker represents "SepLLM (n=128)," starting at approximately 3.0 and decreasing to approximately 2.4 by iteration 140000.
